kind: Q6 comparable development synthesis and deterministic SQL reproduction
label_status: AI-v3 frozen, not independently human validated; original/all-public sensitivities included

protocol.authorization: Vinh explicitly approved Q6 development synthesis and k10 reproducibility check; no commit/push/default promotion.
protocol.label_status: Frozen AI v3 primary/direct anchors; original/all-public sensitivity. Not independently human validated.

primary_tests.reproducibility: Exact per-query baseline and k10 parity with Q5, without interpreting repeated same-query significance as independent confirmation.

protocol.secondary: All seven standard methods plus k10; original/AI-primary/all-public label sensitivity; leave-one-query-out MRR robustness; conservative six-arm Bonferroni bootstrap interval; exact-set sufficiency only.
protocol.fixed: Corpus/vectors/chunk IDs/bodies/versions/ACL, query strings, query embeddings, labels, BM25 preprocessing, models and output20. k-grid reuses exact same depth50 leaf lists. Depth studies invoke actual SQL limits separately, with prefix nesting/tie behavior recorded.
protocol.query_vectors: Exact previously captured query vectors, with matching pinned metadata; no model service or new inference.
protocol.ranking: Canonical rrf_fuse with equal leaf weights and UUID tie-break. No expansion or parent expansion.
protocol.retention_diagnostics: For each anchor group record absent from leaf union, present but lost by fused top20, retained20 but below5, and retained5; record branch ranks and summed RRF score of best available alias. Distinguish branch-union coverage from Recall@20.
protocol.SQL_safety: All BM25/dense calls receive RetrievalContext and central SQL ACL. Every exported ranked ID is rechecked against authorized SQL export. Read-only database; main vector/content and index-definition hashes before/after.
protocol.primary_acceptance: Keep baseline unless evidence survives selection-aware sensitivity and validation gates. No held-out access. AI label independent validation and clean committed review remain open.

statistics.interval: 95% percentile paired query bootstrap; two unadjusted exploratory primary hypotheses; no AI-label uncertainty modeled
statistics.Q6_sensitivity: 100000 paired-query resamples seed20261107; percentile interval at 1-0.05/6 for six Q5-arm selection sensitivity, descriptive only, not fresh confirmation. Leave-one-query-out MRR delta min/max; do not select new parameters.

protocol.latency: Warm unmeasured SQL baseline pass, then measured branch25/50/100 order cyclically rotated by query. Report observed branch/fusion incremental timing, not a clean-machine capacity claim.
protocol.label_coverage: Record newly retrieved chunks outside Q2 pool; do not silently judge them irrelevant or expand labels after outcomes. Report original-label and primary/all-public sensitivity and bounded-pool limitation.
protocol.sufficiency: Reuse only exact judged top5 sets; new sets stay null with coverage.
protocol.gates: Q1/Q2 independent validation and clean review/commit/CI remain pending; this is development measurement only.
protocol.comparison: FTS and BM25 use standard expanded-query configs; dense exact/HNSW raw query; Hybrid raw. Same32 real queries and frozen labels, output20. Reranker model results reused from Q1, verified leaf parity and SQL-authorized IDs on unchanged corpus; no fresh model timing. Do not mix warm SQL/cached-vector latencies with archived full-pipeline timings.

fts.scope: fresh local SQL only; cached vectors for HNSW; no warmup guarantee for added methods; not deployment end-to-end

bm25.scope: fresh local SQL only; cached vectors for HNSW; no warmup guarantee for added methods; not deployment end-to-end

dense_hnsw.scope: fresh local SQL only; cached vectors for HNSW; no warmup guarantee for added methods; not deployment end-to-end

hybrid_raw.scope: warm SQL branches+fusion; cached query vector; excludes model inference

dense_exact.scope: Not freshly measured end-to-end in Q6. Archived reranker quality retained without combining incompatible timing samples.

rerank_top20.scope: Not freshly measured end-to-end in Q6. Archived reranker quality retained without combining incompatible timing samples.

rerank_top50.scope: Not freshly measured end-to-end in Q6. Archived reranker quality retained without combining incompatible timing samples.

security.scope: 32 real dev queries; every fresh or reused output ID checked against central SQL ACL export; not a full adversarial benchmark or M6 security gate

decision.research_baseline: hybrid_raw body embeddings, raw query, exact dense, depth50 per branch, RRF k60, output20, no reranker
decision.k10: promising exploratory candidate, retain as separately named experiment; no default promotion
decision.representations: retain body representation; Q3 primary no clear gain
decision.reranker: retain measured variants as comparisons; Q4 window/fusion no replacement qualifies; no change to locked application pipeline
decision.reason: Same development data cannot independently confirm a selected Q5 secondary signal. Small sample, selection history, label provenance and pending clean committed review prevent final promotion.

limitations: Seven standard rows are comparable for query population, corpus and relevance labels; expanded-query FTS/BM25 and raw Hybrid are explicitly identified.
Archived Q1 reranker inference is reused after current SQL authorization and exact leaf parity on unchanged corpus; no new reranker inference/timing claim.
Outside-Q2-pool passages remain unjudged and may bias expanded-anchor scoring; unknown sufficiency stays null.

Same-data repeat and leave-one-out are reproducibility/robustness checks, not independent confirmation.
